conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.message: That's a long time ago! So, what are some of the main types of machine learning that exist today?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The main types are supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning, each with different approaches to data and problem-solving.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Can you tell me more about the differences between those three types?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Certainly! Supervised learning uses labeled data to make predictions, unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabeled data, and reinforcement learning trains agents through trial and error with rewards.
